info.title: Entropia Manager API
info.description:
Entropia Manager API v2 — Endpoints for inventory, transactions and more.
The HTTP/OpenAPI contract uses camelCase. Pydantic schemas (via `APIModel`) handle
the conversion automatically.

AverageBuyMarkupResponse.title: AverageBuyMarkupResponse
AverageBuyMarkupResponse.description:
``global`` is every BUY transaction, ``current`` only the quantity still
held in open lots.  ``global`` is a Python keyword, hence the alias.

AverageBuyMarkupScopeResponse.title: AverageBuyMarkupScopeResponse
AverageBuyMarkupScopeResponse.description:
One scope of the average buy markup.  ``None`` when there is nothing to
ratio (no BUY yet, no open lot, or a null ``tt``).

ItemFinancialReportEnvelope.title: ItemFinancialReportEnvelope
ItemFinancialReportEnvelope.description: The item id is a legacy dynamic JSON object key.

MiningSessionPrevalidationCreate.title: MiningSessionPrevalidationCreate
MiningSessionPrevalidationCreate.description: Inventory lots selected by the mining-session form.

StockLineResponse.title: StockLineResponse
StockLineResponse.description:
One stock line.

Stackable items produce a single aggregated line per item (``lot_id`` and
``tier_level`` are ``None``). Non-stackable items produce one line per
available physical instance, carrying the ``lot_id`` (and ``tier_level``
when tierable) the client needs to edit the tier via
``PATCH /inventory/lots/{lot_id}/tier``.
